cards.answer: Viktor is a mage whose damage abilities scale with AP and deal magic damage. He fights with an empowered attack, a damaging beam, a slowing field that can stun, and a moving storm.
cards.counterplay: Leave his field and storm, and move away from the beam's path.

facts.claim: Viktor is a mage whose damage abilities scale with AP and deal magic damage.

cards.answer: Viktor collects Hex Fragments from enemies he kills and champion takedowns to permanently augment his abilities. He can augment his ultimate only after augmenting all his basic abilities.
cards.counterplay: Adapt your positioning as his abilities gain additional effects.

citations.quote: Viktor collects Hex Fragments from enemies he kills and enemy champion takedowns.
With every 100 Hex Fragments he obtains, Viktor permanently augments an active ability.

facts.claim: Viktor collects Hex Fragments from enemies he kills and champion takedowns to permanently augment his abilities.

citations.quote: Arcane Storm can be augmented after all of Viktor's basic abilities have been augmented.

facts.claim: He can augment his ultimate only after augmenting all his basic abilities.

cards.priority_reason: His permanent upgrades change the threats his abilities present.

cards.answer: Q deals magic damage to a targeted enemy, shields Viktor, and empowers his next basic attack to deal magic damage. When augmented, its shield is stronger and Viktor gains movement speed after the device hits.
cards.counterplay: Avoid trading into his shield and back away from the empowered attack.

citations.quote: Active: Viktor throws a draining device at the target enemy that deals magic damage. He also gains Discharge and shields himself for a short time.
Discharge: Viktor's next basic attack is empowered to become non-projectile and deal modified magic damage.

facts.claim: Q deals magic damage to a targeted enemy, shields Viktor, and empowers his next basic attack to deal magic damage.

citations.quote: Augment: After the device hits, Viktor gains bonus movement speed for a short time, and the shield is increased.

facts.claim: When augmented, its shield is stronger and Viktor gains movement speed after the device hits.

cards.priority_reason: Defines his close trading pattern and defensive response.

cards.answer: W creates a field that activates after a brief delay, slowing enemies inside and stunning those who remain too long. When augmented, his other abilities slow enemies they hit, except the storm's persistent damage.
cards.counterplay: Leave the field promptly and avoid routes that force you through it.

citations.quote: Active: Viktor deploys a gravity field that remains at the target location for a few seconds. After a brief delay, the field will activate to continually slow enemies within and inflict stack of Heavy Gravity.
Enemies who stay in the field for too long become stunned.

facts.claim: W creates a field that activates after a brief delay, slowing enemies inside and stunning those who remain too long.

citations.quote: Augment: Magnetize — Viktor's other abilities, excluding Arcane Storm's persistent damage, slow enemies hit by 20% for 1 second.

facts.claim: When augmented, his other abilities slow enemies they hit, except the storm's persistent damage.

cards.priority_reason: The field can turn restricted movement into a stun.

cards.answer: E fires a beam along a path, dealing magic damage to enemies hit. When augmented, the same path explodes after a delay for additional magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the beam's path and avoid lingering there after it passes.

citations.quote: Active: Viktor fires an energy beam along the target path that deals magic damage to enemies hit.

facts.claim: E fires a beam along a path, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

citations.quote: Augment: After a brief delay, the path explodes along the beam's wake, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.

facts.claim: When augmented, the same path explodes after a delay for additional magic damage.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing the delayed explosion helps avoid repeated damage.

cards.answer: R initially deals magic damage and interrupts channels, then remains as a moving storm that repeatedly deals magic damage. Viktor can redirect it to a location or make it follow an enemy champion. When augmented, it moves faster and grows larger and lasts longer when an enemy champion it damaged is taken down.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the storm and avoid channeling within Viktor's reach while his ultimate is available.

citations.quote: Active: Viktor conjures an arcane singularity at the target location, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area and disrupting their channeled abilities.
The singularity then remains active as a moving storm for 6.5 seconds, striking a bolt of electricity onto enemies within it every second to deal magic damage

facts.claim: Viktor can redirect it to a location or make it follow an enemy champion.

citations.quote: Augment: Perfect Storm — The singularity moves 25% faster. Additionally, whenever an enemy champion is taken down after being damaged by Arcane Storm, the storm's size is increased by 40% and its duration is extended by 3 seconds.

facts.claim: When augmented, it moves faster and grows larger and lasts longer when an enemy champion it damaged is taken down.
